title: Hierarchical Product Catalog
purpose: Text corpus for hierarchical RAG learning and validation.

products.description: A room-scale smart heat-pump controller for quiet, schedule-based heating and cooling in apartments and small offices.
quick_start: Switch off HVAC control power.
Connect labelled terminals and restore power.
Run the compatibility and sensor test.
how_to_use: Choose a schedule or set a temporary target.
Review runtime trends before changing limits.

error_codes.resolution: Reseat the wall sensor and run Sensor Test.
Wait five minutes; do not switch modes repeatedly.
Check schedule overlap and the heating/cooling deadband.

variants.description: Adds remote occupancy sensor and humidity control.

products.description: A connected ventilation controller that balances fresh-air intake, fan speed, and humidity targets for a single indoor zone.
quick_start: Mount away from direct exhaust flow.
Connect fan and power leads to labelled terminals.
Set preferred CO2 and humidity thresholds.
how_to_use: Use Auto mode for normal operation.
Select Boost mode for short high-occupancy periods.

error_codes.resolution: Clean the intake grille and restart calibration.
Check breaker, wiring, and fan service switch.
Move the sensor away from steam or open windows.

variants.description: Manual fan curves and app alerts.
Adds CO2-driven fan control and weekly reports.

products.description: A keypad smart deadbolt for residential and small-office doors, with role-based entry codes and an audit trail.
quick_start: Install with the door open and bolt fully aligned.
Create owner and backup codes.
Test lock, unlock, and auto-lock before closing the door.
how_to_use: Use temporary codes for visitors.
Review access history after a security event.

error_codes.resolution: Open the door and correct strike alignment.
Confirm that the code is active and not expired.
Use the mechanical key and replace all batteries.

variants.description: Keypad, mechanical key, and mobile unlock.
Adds encrypted fob access for staff or guests.

products.description: A 4K entry camera with person detection, local recording, privacy masks, and administrator-only clip export.
quick_start: Mount with a clear view and stable network signal.
Apply updates before enabling recording.
Draw privacy masks before defining motion zones.
how_to_use: Review Events for detected activity.
Export only required clips and keep access roles current.

error_codes.resolution: Check power, network link, and recorder status.
Archive required clips or revise retention policy.
Separate the motion zone from masked pixels.

variants.description: Desk or wall mount with privacy shutter.

products.description: A whole-home flow monitor that identifies sustained unusual water use and can notify designated household members.
quick_start: Fit the sensor around the labelled supply pipe.
Run a baseline flow calibration with all fixtures closed.
Name the monitored property and alert recipients.
how_to_use: Review Flow History before classifying a use as unusual.
Use Maintenance Mode during planned plumbing work.

error_codes.resolution: Inspect fixtures and appliances for continuous water use.
Repeat calibration when no water is running.
Use manual override and contact a qualified plumber.

products.description: A compact battery leak sensor for cabinets, water heaters, washing machines, and other localized risk points.
quick_start: Place contacts flat on a dry surface.
Label the exact room and appliance in the app.
Test with a few drops of clean water, then dry contacts.
how_to_use: Treat every wet-sensor alert as urgent.
Replace the battery when the app prompts you.

error_codes.resolution: Resolve the leak, dry contacts, then reset.
Replace with the specified coin cell.
Move the hub or add a compatible repeater.

products.description: A 55-inch collaboration display for meeting rooms, with wireless presentation, digital whiteboard, and managed guest access.
quick_start: Mount securely or lock the mobile stand.
Connect network and register the room name.
Set guest-presentation and whiteboard retention policies.
how_to_use: Start a session from the Room panel.
Clear the whiteboard after each confidential meeting.

error_codes.resolution: Check source cable and selected input.
Confirm guest mode and network isolation settings.
Run calibration from Admin Settings.

variants.description: Adds rolling stand and cable tray.

products.description: A USB and Bluetooth speakerphone for small meeting spaces, with beamforming microphones and call-quality diagnostics.
quick_start: Place centrally on a stable table.
Connect by USB for managed-room use or pair by Bluetooth.
Run the microphone test before the first meeting.
how_to_use: Press Mute to disable microphones locally.
Use Diagnostics after repeated call-quality complaints.

error_codes.resolution: Check physical Mute button and meeting-app mute state.
Remove old pairing records and pair again.
Move device away from display speakers and reduce volume.

products.description: A managed desk power unit with eight AC outlets, USB-C charging, individual outlet names, and energy-use reporting.
quick_start: Connect directly to a grounded wall outlet.
Label each outlet by connected equipment.
Set schedules only for devices that can safely lose power.
how_to_use: Review standby usage weekly.
Use remote restart only for approved equipment.

error_codes.resolution: Remove high-wattage devices and press Reset.
Enable the named outlet and inspect device power.
Replace the unit; protection is no longer reliable.

variants.description: 19-inch rack ears and rear outlet layout.

products.description: A Wi-Fi 6E mesh node for managed offices, providing wired uplink, guest network support, and device-health reporting.
quick_start: Connect the first node to the router by Ethernet.
Place additional nodes within reliable signal range.
Create separate staff and guest network profiles.
how_to_use: Check mesh health before moving a node.
Run a network test after firmware updates.

error_codes.resolution: Check Ethernet connection and router port.
Move the node closer to a powered mesh node.
Review VLAN and guest-access settings.

products.description: A commuter e-bike with pedal assist, integrated lights, removable battery, and service reminders for everyday city travel.
quick_start: Charge the battery indoors using the supplied charger.
Adjust saddle height and test brake levers.
Pair the bike app and record the frame number.
how_to_use: Start in low assist until familiar with handling.
Lock battery and frame when parked.

error_codes.resolution: Check battery charge and seat the battery fully.
Release brake levers and inspect for damage.
Book a service inspection before intensive use.

variants.description: Adds suspension fork and extended battery.

products.description: A long-tail cargo e-bike for shopping, child-seat compatible loads, and short local deliveries, with reinforced frame and load-aware assist.
quick_start: Have a dealer check frame, brakes, and cargo rail fittings.
Charge battery fully and calibrate load-aware assist.
Install approved cargo accessories only.
how_to_use: Secure load low and evenly on the frame.
Use lower assist when starting with a heavy load.

error_codes.resolution: Remove load, restart, and schedule dealer inspection.
Stop riding, shade the battery, and allow it to cool.
Replace pads before further cargo use.

products.description: A compact Bluetooth travel tag with last-seen location, separation alerts, and replaceable battery for luggage and equipment cases.
quick_start: Remove battery tab and pair from the travel app.
Name the item and set a separation alert distance.
Test the sound function before travel.
how_to_use: Use Last Seen as an approximate location, not live GPS.
Replace battery when low-battery notification appears.

error_codes.resolution: Enable Bluetooth and move within nearby range.
Replace battery and confirm the tag is paired.
Check phone network and wait for a participating device update.

products.description: A 65 W USB-C travel charger with interchangeable regional plugs and intelligent power allocation for laptops, phones, and accessories.
quick_start: Fit the correct regional plug until it clicks.
Connect highest-power device to USB-C port 1.
Check that the wall outlet is undamaged and compatible.
how_to_use: Disconnect before changing plug heads.
Use certified cables appropriate for device power requirements.

error_codes.resolution: Reconnect cable and use a certified USB-C PD cable.
Unplug, let charger cool, and reduce connected load.
Remove and refit the plug head until fully engaged.

products.description: A dual-mode coffee maker with drip and single-serve functions, programmable start, strength control, and cleaning reminders.
quick_start: Rinse removable parts and run one water-only cycle.
Set local time and preferred strength.
For scheduled brew, prepare water and grounds before bedtime.
how_to_use: Use single-serve mode with the correct adapter.
Run cleaning cycle when the maintenance alert appears.

error_codes.resolution: Fill reservoir above the minimum mark.
Center carafe and clean the warming plate.
Run the guided descale cycle before brewing again.

products.description: A compact 12-bottle preservation cabinet with adjustable temperature zones, humidity display, and door-open notifications.
quick_start: Place on a level surface with rear ventilation clearance.
Allow two hours of stabilization before loading.
Set upper and lower zone targets, then enable door alerts.
how_to_use: Arrange bottles without blocking internal airflow.
Review temperature history after a power interruption.

error_codes.resolution: Close door fully and inspect gasket alignment.
Restart appliance and request service if fault returns.
Wait for delay to finish before changing target again.

products.description: A robot vacuum for hard floors and low-pile carpets, with room mapping, no-go zones, scheduled runs, and washable filter.
quick_start: Place dock against a clear wall and charge fully.
Map each floor with cords and loose objects removed.
Set no-go zones for stairs, cables, and pet areas.
how_to_use: Choose rooms or a whole-floor task.
Empty bin after major runs and dry mop pad after use.

error_codes.resolution: Clear obstacle and resume from open floor.
Check dock power and approach path.
Remove hair or thread from brush and end caps.

products.description: A compact garment steamer with quick heat-up, removable water tank, and auto-off protection for household clothing care.
quick_start: Fill tank with clean water and lock it in place.
Power on while upright and wait for ready indicator.
Test steam away from garments first.
how_to_use: Keep fabric taut and move slowly from top to bottom.
Empty tank after use and allow unit to cool upright.

error_codes.resolution: Refit tank until it clicks.
Use the approved cleaning process; do not use vinegar.
Power off, let cool, and inspect air vents.

products.description: A HEPA air purifier for bedrooms and workspaces, with particle sensing, automatic fan speed, and filter-life reporting.
quick_start: Remove filter packaging before first use.
Place 30 cm from walls or furniture.
Select Auto mode and allow 20 minutes for baseline reading.
how_to_use: Use Sleep mode overnight for lower noise.
Replace filter only when prompted or airflow falls noticeably.

error_codes.resolution: Remove packaging and reseat filter panel.
Clean sensor inlet with dry soft brush.
Inspect filter condition and intake clearance.

variants.description: Adds enhanced carbon filter and pollen mode.

products.description: A bedside circadian light with timed warm-to-cool transitions, wake-up routines, and a simple local control dial.
quick_start: Place on a stable bedside surface.
Set local time and preferred wake window.
Create a gentle morning routine before enabling it.
how_to_use: Turn the dial for brightness and press to change mode.
Use wind-down routine in the hour before sleep.

error_codes.resolution: Set time in the companion app or local menu.
Check schedule, time zone, and power connection.
Reduce brightness, allow cooling, and check ventilation.
